title: Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models
authors: J. Wei, Y. Tay, R. Bommasani, et al. (16 authors)
before: Scaling laws described smooth, predictable improvement in loss.
problem: Some abilities appeared absent at small scale and present at large scale, which smooth curves do not explain.
breakthrough: A catalogue of tasks where performance jumps sharply past a scale threshold, framed as emergence.
why: It shaped how the field talked about capability and risk for two years, and provoked a serious rebuttal in 2023.
next: Schaeffer's mirage paper argued the jumps come from discontinuous metrics, not the models.
inherits: An unresolved argument about whether capability arrives smoothly or in steps.
